name: Noctula
personality: Proud of her trained physique; loves city life, fistfights and training.
story: She left a warlike tribe, rejecting rural life and the local men, and moved to the imperial capital Dagsion, which she had admired since childhood. She is one of the cheapest recruits (Renown 3 on Theodora's route).

personalSkill.name: Warrior's Clarity
personalSkill.effect: After combat, Avo+3 until unit's next phase. Lv20 adds a 10% chance of Avo+10; Lv35 raises it to 20%.

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics B; KeenGamer A (cheapest strong recruit). Reddit: Pugilist → Warrior is the standard dodge tank; Clarity's Avo stacks per combat (single report).

why: No support needed for Noctula. Theodora (Renown 3) would be a little earlier, but that roster was already full, so Cai keeps the four armies level.
recruit.tip: No item, quest or support: just Renown 4.

build.notes: Gladiator on joining (about Lv 15 in Ch 6), Pugilist at Lv 20 until Attack, Get Back is mastered. Brigand in Ch 8 for Regroup: it keeps gauntlets, so the Dodge Gauntlets stay on. Back to Pugilist through Part II. War Monk in Part III keeps her Spd 60; Battlemaster needs Sword A, which she avoids.

guide.summary: Pugilist grows HP 65, Spd 55, Def 50 on her and adds Brawl Avo +3; Warrior's Clarity and Dodge Gauntlets stack more Avo. She stays Pugilist through Part II and goes War Monk in Part III to keep her Spd.
guide.playstyle: Bait enemy phase from forests and thickets with Ultand beside her (Patch Up heals, Pray for Safety stops crits) and Ninae on the other side against mages. Counter with gauntlets. Res grows 20%: mages are her death.
keys: Fight with gauntlets every map and train Gauntlet at Arena Warrior Training (Sword, Axe, Gauntlet).
Get Dodge Gauntlets (S tier) and make them her refine project.
Master Attack, Get Back: Avo +10 on every art.
Ch 8: a Brigand stint for Regroup (Avo +20 after a miss). Brigand keeps gauntlets.
Fight with Ultand next to her from Ch 7: Patch Up heals her after every enemy-phase fight and Pray for Safety adds Ddg +10 (+20 at Lv 35): crit avoid, not dodge.
Against mages, keep Ninae on her other side: Spirits' Guidance gives her Hit/Avo +10 when the foe uses magic.
Part II Ch 5: park her at the Onager's far range to waste its shots.
watch: Res growth 20%: never end a turn in mage range.
Sword is avoided, so Warrior and Battlemaster are poor fits.
Dodge Gauntlets 3 + Phantom Ring 3 = 6 weight: keep it there (Da Mina Gauntlets add 1 on player phase). Never add a shield: lost Attack Speed costs both doubles and dodges.
Inventory: 4 core (Dodge and Da Mina Gauntlets, Phantom Ring, Concoction), 2 open for Pure Water or a Miranilla Juice. Part II: all six carried in from Ch 12.

stages.goal: Gauntlet C for Pugilist. Warrior's Clarity (innate): Avo +3 after each combat until her next phase.
stages.exit: Leave at Lv 20 with Gauntlet C (Pugilist exam at 75%).

training.how: Arena Warrior Training (Sword, Axe, Gauntlet); fight with gauntlets, inn Auto-Training; Gladiator trains Gauntlet
Arena Heavy Training (Spear, Authority, Axe, Heavy); Axe is her preferred rank

tips: Joins in Ch 6 at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class. Ursa's Right Claw only comes with a Lv 20+ Pugilist recruit, so a Ch 6 Noctula doesn't bring it
